source: Reduced from a .backup copy of com.monocode.second/monocode.db taken 2026-10-22 (ADE-64): the omp session where a relaunch Continue was steered 11 ms after it opened its turn. record: the session as session_store.rs saves it, with only its last block before the relaunch (the interrupt notice); the project folder is the test project and the title is a neutral stand-in for the real one, which quoted a user prompt. miss: the opener, the steer and the error notice as saved after that relaunch, verbatim; the opener has durationMs 14 though omp ran the turn on (reasoning, five tool calls and a reply follow the notice).
